answer: One defense is a stake-locked vault paired with slashing. Every agent must lock real capital in a time-locked account before it can vote or earn, and each identity whole history hangs on that single thread of escrowed value. When a fake account is caught spawning duplicates, its locked stake is slashed, so a sybil farmer pays upfront and loses it all the moment coordination is detected. Honest agents keep their vaults intact, and their reputation signal strengthens with every clean epoch, making identity a pearl that is expensive to forge and ruinous to fake.
